The potential impact of the documentary is likely to be significant within the food industry and among consumers. By exposing the harsh realities of factory farming, the content may shift public opinion, leading to a decrease in demand for factory-farmed products and an increase in interest in vegan and cruelty-free alternatives. This could drive changes in consumer behavior and potentially influence corporate practices within the agricultural sector.
